business_process: Spillway gate operation and reservoir management
description: Remote and local operation of spillway gates at 47 gated dams to hold reservoir levels and pass floods under each license and EAP
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Uncontrolled release or failure to pass a flood endangers people downstream (18 CFR 12.3(b)(4)(ii)); during a flood the tolerable outage of remote gate control falls to about 1 hour, which local crews must cover
manual_workaround: Operators dispatched to local gate panels; gates held in position; hand-crank and portable generator procedures
dependent_third_parties: Gate PLC vendor; telecom carriers for the OT WAN
dependent_people_or_facilities: HOC operators; plant operators and on-call crews at 47 gated dams
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None by design: gate control does not depend on SYS-G1 or corporate networks (separate OT identity domain). Constructors' commissioning connections at rehabilitation sites are a cross-division exposure (gap 1)

business_process: Dam safety monitoring and EAP early warning
description: Automated instrument reading at 68 dams, river and rain gauges, threshold alarms, and EAP siren activation at 21 dams
process_owner: Vice President, Dam Safety (Chief Dam Safety Engineer)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Missed seepage, piezometer, or reservoir alarms delay EAP action; unusual instrument readings are reportable conditions (18 CFR 12.3(b)(4)(viii))
manual_workaround: Manual instrument readings by dam safety technicians; local siren activation; increased inspection frequency
dependent_third_parties: Instrumentation hardware vendor; cellular carriers for gauges
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Engineering's DSMS (SYS-E1) analyzes the data and runs AI-001, but alarms and sirens run locally in SYS-H4 and do not depend on the DSMS

business_process: Real-time fleet operations at the Hydro Operations Centers
description: Around-the-clock unit dispatch, AGC response, and gate commands for 41 developments (10,140 MW) from HOC-A, with HOC-B as backup
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Generator Operator obligations to the Balancing Authorities; loss of HOC control strands 10,140 MW; the 2026-06-13 failover took 2.6 hours against a 2-hour RTO
manual_workaround: Fail over to HOC-B; transfer plants to local control with staffed control rooms
dependent_third_parties: 3 Balancing Authorities and Transmission Operators (ICCP); OT WAN carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: HOC operators and shift supervisors; HOC-A and HOC-B
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Group SOC (SYS-G2) monitors the HOC sensors; no dependency on corporate identity

description: PACS for the HOC Physical Security Perimeters, cameras and intrusion detection at Group 1 and 2 dams, and security dispatch
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: CIP-006-6 Part 1.5 requires an alarm or alert to incident responders within 15 minutes of detected unauthorized access to a PSP; Group 1 and 2 dam Security Plans depend on cameras
manual_workaround: Post security officers at HOC entrances; increased patrols at Group 1 and 2 dams
dependent_people_or_facilities: Security officers; security dispatch at HOC-A
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds the group SOC for combined physical and cyber events

description: Blackstart capability at 5 developments listed in the Transmission Operators' restoration plans
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Restoration plans depend on these units after a regional blackout; low impact BES Cyber Systems (CIP-002 criterion 3.4)
manual_workaround: Local start procedures with on-site crews and diesel auxiliaries
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None beyond Hydro

business_process: Unit control and generation at plants
description: Unit PLCs, governors, exciters, and plant HMIs at 54 developments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $17.0 million of Hydro revenue per day; units can run in local control, but PLC logic backups older than 12 months at 12 plants lengthen recovery
manual_workaround: Local manual control; take units offline and spill water if needed
dependent_third_parties: Governor and excitation OEM (55% of units); PLC vendors
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Constructors installs and commissions new unit and gate PLCs during rehabilitation projects

description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for 45,000 workforce users and about 6,000 contractor and subcontractor users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every IT system in every division federates to SYS-G1. Hydro OT does not, by design
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; cached credentials on field devices
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by all IT processes in all divisions, including the DSMS, the FPE, and the scheduling platform

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, OT sensor console, and incident handling for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: CIP-008-6 and DFARS 252.204-7012 reporting clocks depend on SOC facts; OT sensor alerts from the HOCs are reviewed here
manual_workaround: Retainer firm tooling; OT security team reviews sensor consoles locally at the HOCs
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; incident response retainer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions; the OT security team relies on the SOC for 24x7 alert triage

business_process: Cloud landing zones and hub networks
description: Hub networks, guardrails, keys, logging, and backup vault on providers A and B, including the government-community region
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The DSMS, the FPE, and the scheduling platform run behind the hubs; DSMS client contracts commit to 99.5% availability
manual_workaround: Direct provider failover paths; DSMS warm standby region
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: DSMS (Engineering), FPE (Constructors and Engineering), scheduling (Hydro)

description: Collect instrument data from 280 dams (212 client dams and 68 Hydro dams), apply thresholds, and alert owners
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients rely on DSMS alerts as part of their dam safety programs; contracts commit to 99.5% availability and 1-hour data loss at most
manual_workaround: Clients and Hydro fall back to local alarms and manual readings; DSMS staff phone clients with any alert backlog
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; cellular carriers used by clients
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Hydro's 68 dams use it for analysis; runs on SYS-G3 and uses SYS-G1 for staff sign-in

description: Day-ahead and real-time schedules, offtaker settlements, and ancillary service bids
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Missed day-ahead schedules lead to imbalance charges and contract penalties
manual_workaround: Phone and email schedules to the Balancing Authorities; prior-day schedule repeated
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Runs on the group cloud platform (SYS-G3, provider A) and uses SYS-G1 sign-in

business_process: Emergency engineering support to dam owners
description: On-call engineering for floods and incidents: breach and inundation analysis and repair design
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Owners, including Hydro, call for analysis during floods and incidents; delays can affect EAP decisions
manual_workaround: Printed inundation maps; laptops with local models
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Supports Hydro's Chief Dam Safety Engineer during incidents (P08)

description: Daily construction work at about 410 projects: drawings, RFIs, submittals, schedules, and quality records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $25.5 million of Constructors revenue per day; idle crews and equipment cost money quickly, and liquidated damages apply on many contracts
manual_workaround: Printed drawings at jobsites; offline tablets; phone RFIs
dependent_people_or_facilities: Project managers; superintendents; about 19,800 craft workers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 sign-in; corporate WAN at jobsites; work for Hydro at 7 plants

business_process: Corporate network, WAN, and jobsite connectivity
description: Links to 96 offices, plant administrative networks, and about 410 jobsite trailers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Jobsites can work offline for a day; plant administrative networks are separate from OT
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at jobsites and plants; offline drawings on tablets
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Constructors' jobsites and Engineering offices; not Hydro OT

business_process: NERC, FERC, and DOE event and compliance reporting
description: EOP-004, CIP-008 and CIP-003 notifications, DOE-417 when required, 18 CFR 12.10 reports, and FERC security reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reporting clocks keep running during an outage (CIP-008-6 Part 4.2: 1 hour; 18 CFR 12.10(a)(1): preferably within 72 hours)
manual_workaround: Phone reports from the printed contact list; paper forms
dependent_people_or_facilities: NERC compliance team; Chief Dam Safety Engineer's staff
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on the group SOC for incident facts and on the General Counsel for the notification matrix

business_process: Federal Projects Enclave and CUI work
description: CUI drawings, submittals, and correspondence for 11 USACE contracts (and 14 Engineering A-E contracts)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract performance and DFARS 252.204-7012 reporting; CUI must not move to other systems while the FPE is down
manual_workaround: Pause CUI work; government-provided systems where the contracting officer allows
dependent_people_or_facilities: Federal project teams in Constructors and Engineering
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Shared by Constructors and Engineering; inherits group identity and SOC controls

business_process: Pay applications, subcontractor payments, and progress billing
description: Monthly pay applications to owners and payments to about 5,200 subcontractors and suppliers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow and payment fraud risk (business email compromise targeting payment changes)
manual_workaround: Paper pay applications; call-back verification of every banking change
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: ERP and payments run on SYS-G4 (corporate)

description: Machine learning model that flags unusual instrument behavior for review
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Rules-based thresholds keep running without the model; but 31 Hydro dams now rely on AI-001 alerts to set manual reading frequency
manual_workaround: Rules-based thresholds only; return the 31 dams to weekly manual readings
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Hydro dam safety teams use its alerts (P10 condition)

business_process: Commissioning and testing at owner sites
description: Programming and testing new PLCs, gates, and equipment at owner sites, including Hydro plants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Commissioning windows are scheduled with plant outages; delays push outage end dates
manual_workaround: Reschedule commissioning; vendor technicians under Hydro escort
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Connects to Hydro OT during rehabilitation projects (gap 1)

description: Quantity takeoff, pricing, and bid submission
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bid due dates are fixed; a missed bid loses the opportunity
manual_workaround: Manual estimates; bid bonds and forms from offline copies
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None beyond SYS-G1

description: Weekly craft payroll for about 19,800 craft workers and biweekly payroll for salaried staff; onboarding and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekly craft payroll under collective bargaining agreements and certified payroll on federal contracts; terminations drive CIP-004 access removal within 24 hours
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll; manual checks for new hires; paper termination notices to the OT security team
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Termination events feed SYS-G1 and the OT identity domain (CIP-004-7 Part 5.1)

description: Close, consolidation, and SEC filings including Form 8-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; a Form 8-K Item 1.05 filing is due 4 business days after a materiality determination
manual_workaround: Manual consolidation; outside counsel filing agent
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs incident facts from the SOC and all three divisions

description: Design, analysis, and sealed reports for about 1,900 active engagements
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client deadlines; professional obligations for sealed work
manual_workaround: Work from local copies; extend deadlines with clients
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Client CEII is stored here and in SYS-G6 shares (gap 6)

description: Purchase orders, vendor onboarding, and payments for about 3,400 vendors
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly payment cycles; supplier terms tolerate short delays
manual_workaround: Manual purchase orders; priority payments by phone with call-back verification
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: CIP-013 procurement steps for Hydro run through this process

description: Inspection apps, drone and ROV imagery, and crack detection (AI-004)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Inspection reports have weeks of lead time
manual_workaround: Paper inspection forms; process imagery later
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None

description: Campground and boat ramp reservations and public flow and lake level information
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Public flow information supports boater safety below dams; reservations can wait
manual_workaround: Phone line; posted notices; recorded flow line
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Public website on the group cloud platform

description: Location, hours, and maintenance alerts for about 6,900 machines
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Maintenance can follow manual hour meters for days
manual_workaround: Manual hour meter readings
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None
